prompt:
Move a value replacing a table out of the table region (#506)

Replacing a table with a plain value reused the forward scan meant for
the value-to-table direction, so the value was inserted just before the
next table header, inside the preceding table's body region. On
round-trip the key became a child of that table. Route the
table-to-value direction through append(), which already places values
before the first table.

Fixes #504
